title: Archive every completed task packet and make canonical references survive the move
goal: Move every .harness/tasks manifest whose status is completed (87 of them) plus its evidence into .harness/archive/<YYYY-MM>/, so the live trees only hold work that is still open, and make the canonical .harness/tasks/<task-id>/ and .harness/evidence/<task-id>/ references resolve against the archive the way readTaskManifest already does for manifests. Without that resolution the round would have taken check:task-packet from 42 to 86 warnings and turned check:harness-docs red on three docs/reviews links, which is the same failure class that left 28 permanent false warnings behind the 2026-09-25 round.
findings: 87 manifests carried status completed and 1 carried in-progress (2026-10-27-codebase-simplification-program), so the live .harness/tasks tree was 99% closed work.
Moving the manifests was already safe: readTaskManifest falls back to .harness/archive/<month>/tasks/<task-id>/manifest.json, and check-task-packet resolves Linkage Task Manifest through it.

Moving the evidence was not safe: check-task-packet tested Review File and Contract Anchors with a plain fs.existsSync, so the round took its warning count from 42 to 86 and check-doc-links reported 3 missing targets in docs/reviews/*.md.
28 of the 42 warnings that existed before the round were the same false positive for tasks archived on 2026-09-25, so the pre-round baseline was itself contaminated by the absent resolver.

Two evidence artifacts were deliberately left in place: .harness/evidence/2026-09-10-tenant-verification-and-gray/artifacts/browser/ holds two pngs that PR #427 rewrote at the old path after that task was archived (62609/39527 bytes against 60379/39304 in the archive), and .harness/evidence/2026-09-25-pr347-governance-body.md plus 2026-09-27-v0130-pr-body.md are unattached PR bodies referenced by nothing.

in: git mv 87 completed task directories into .harness/archive/<YYYY-MM>/tasks/ and 86 matching evidence directories into .harness/archive/<YYYY-MM>/evidence/
git mv three orphan evidence directories (2026-10-24-session-device-style, 2026-10-24-tenant-login-recovery, 2026-10-25-dual-mode-e2e-smoke) into .harness/archive/2026-10/evidence/
Add findArchivedReferencePath and resolveArchiveAwarePath to scripts/task-manifest.mjs, sharing the archive-month enumeration with findArchivedTaskManifestPath
Use the resolver for Review File and Contract Anchors in scripts/harness/check-task-packet.mjs
Let scripts/harness/check-doc-links.mjs accept links whose canonical .harness/{tasks,evidence} target moved into the archive
Rewrite .harness/ARCHIVE.md statistics from measured directory counts and add the 2026-10-29 round with its residuals
Register FR-019 and record the round in .harness/STATUS.md
out: Moving docs/harness/tasks/*.task.md: earlier rounds kept the packet docs in place so the structural checks keep applying to historical packets
Archiving or editing 2026-10-27-codebase-simplification-program, which is still in-progress
Deleting or overwriting any artifact, including the two diverged pngs and the two unattached PR bodies
Changing the no-artifacts-is-an-error semantics of check-evidence and check-review, which is gate policy
Any backend, frontend, workflow, Sonar or dependency change

implementationNotes: Selection is by manifest status === completed, not by directory name; the archive month is the task id's YYYY-MM prefix so a cross-month task lands in its start month and the counts stay recomputable.
Every move was checked for target collisions before running: 176 moves, 0 collisions.

resolveArchiveAwarePath tries the live path first and then walks archive months newest-first over one table (ARCHIVABLE_TREES) because tasks/ and evidence/ share the same <task-id>/<remainder> layout.
check-doc-links only applies the fallback to targets that resolve inside the repository root; links pointing elsewhere keep their previous verdict.
The invariant being asserted is that a reference stays resolvable, not that a file is in the live tree, so an empty .harness/tasks after a future round still passes.

executionRoles.implementerPosture: Move first, measure the damage, then close only the class of damage the move created. Never delete or overwrite to make a check green.
reviewerPosture: Recompute the per-month counts from the directory tree and compare them with .harness/ARCHIVE.md.
Confirm every move is a git mv, so no file content changed and history is preserved.
Confirm the resolver tries the live path first and that a reference missing from both trees still warns.
Confirm no artifact was deleted or overwritten, in particular the diverged pngs and the unattached PR bodies.
Confirm the no-artifacts-is-an-error behaviour of check-evidence and check-review is unchanged.

check:harness-docs: 3 findings after the moves, 0 after the fallback
